line_text: My, such outlandish clothes! Are you from out of town, perchance? You don't look like gentry...

line_text: Vayne has certainly gone up in the world. Why, we often played as children, he and I. Perhaps I was the one being played, now I think on it.

speaker: Hesitant Traveler

speaker: Proud Horticulturist
line_text: Look, even at this height, greenery abounds! Shrubbery in the skies! And you're looking at the bloke who made it happen...and a few gil!

speaker: Pleasant Woman
line_text: Peaceful... So very peaceful up here. Hmm? Something going on below, you say? Whatever it is, I assure you it will have small effect on our little circle. I daresay peace will last as long as the Empire's glory—forever.

speaker: Bristly Mother
line_text: I'd appreciate a bit more quiet, thank you very much. If she wakes, I'll have you to thank.

trigger: requested by カット.カット２
speaker: no name shown; Vayne
line_text: It is the only way to avert war! / It is a war of necessity. / Your Lady Ashe herself is bent on it. She desires it above all else. / She will not rest until her revenge is full-wrought.

trigger: requested by カット.カット３
speaker: Larsa; Vayne
line_text: I fear you misread her intent. She would sooner shun war than embrace it. / You are young, Larsa. / And you presume beyond your ken! / Then let us look closer. Judge Gabranth!

trigger: requested by カット.カット４
speaker: Vayne; Gabranth
line_text: I would have you seek after the Lady Ashe... / and adjudge whether she makes overtures of peace, or war. / Yours shall be the eyes of the Empire. / And should I espy war, I am to put her to the sword. / Is that your wish, Excellency?

trigger: requested by カット.カット５
speaker: Larsa
line_text: It will not come to that, I am sure. I have faith in her—faith in you both.

trigger: requested by カット.カット６
speaker: Larsa; no name shown
line_text: On you, Gabranth, shall I wager all our fortunes. / As you will.

trigger: requested by カット.カット７
speaker: Doctor Cid; no name shown
line_text: That so sweet a child could be your brother is hard to believe. / Larsa is as he should be. / What's that, Venat? / Ah, taken the bait already, have they? Splendid. / The Occuria have given the Princess her Treaty-Blade.

trigger: requested by カット.カット８
speaker: Vayne
line_text: The gods have chosen their scribe, to write history as they deem fit.

trigger: requested by カット.カット９
speaker: Vayne; Doctor Cid
line_text: Yes, and she with fresh nethicite to aid her. / To hell with the Occuria and their stones! What good a power that cannot be harnessed? / Baubles best-suited for study, no more. / We conquered two kingdoms, that you might study these "baubles." / Oh, I am grateful for the sacrifice. / Without it, manufacted nethicite would have eluded us— an unrivaled weapon, I warrant you. / Tell me, Venat. Have I not been an apt pupil?

trigger: requested by カット.カット１０
speaker: ヴェーネス (script label, Venat)
line_text: My counsel did but guide your able hand.

trigger: requested by カット.カット１１
speaker: ヴェーネス (script label, Venat)
line_text: Through power of Man, the Stones did you perfect. / Yes. So much accomplished in six fleeting years. / Man's fervor o'er all obstacles prevailing.

trigger: requested by カット.カット１２
speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: Our lives are much too short. / You undying might waste long centuries away, but we, I fear, cannot.

trigger: requested by カット.カット１３
speaker: Vayne; no name shown
line_text: Just so. Had we more time, we might have availed ourselves of more "prudent" measures. / Your greatest work still lies before you.

trigger: requested by カット.カット１４
speaker: no name shown
line_text: Not lightly will the Occuria allow you to wrest the reins of History from their grasp, back into to the hands of Man. / Indeed. What claim does Gerun have on history's reins... / seated on throne immortal, rent from time?

trigger: requested by カット.カット１５
speaker: ヴェーネス (script label, Venat)
line_text: For your ascendance, Vayne, I offer prayer. May you attain all that which is your due.

trigger: requested by カット.カット１６
speaker: Vayne
line_text: Attain it I shall. / For too long have my deeds gone unrewarded.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: 元老院A (script label, Senate A); 元老院B (script label, Senate B)
line_text: What possible cause could we have to lay hand on our Emperor? / A deception and an outrage! The Senate will not stand for this!

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Judge Drace; Vayne; Judge Bergan; Judge Zargabaath
line_text: A viper amongst our Senators!? / With Chairman Gregoroth as its head. With what dignity remained him, he confessed to the poisoning and passed his own sentence. / A viper with many tails. Much of the Senate is culpable. / We had no choice but to strip the Senate of authority and assign powers of autocracy to myself until such time as— / Spare me your lies! I see the serpent coiled here before me! / Drace, you speak too freely! / Zargabaath! Do not tell me you join in this mummer's farce! / With Rozarria poised to invade at any moment, our leader must have a free hand.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Vayne
line_text: The once-great House Solidor is now reduced to myself and my dear brother Larsa.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Judge Drace
line_text: Surely you would not go so far! / Vayne Solidor! / As Judge Magister and upholder of the law, I hereby place you under arrest!

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Judge Bergan
line_text: You misunderstand. Vayne did not make himself autocrat. It was the very Ministry of Law which you serve. / When you bared your sword at His Excellency, you bared your sword at the law. / Do you see it now, Drace?

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Judge Drace
line_text: You wear the mummer's motley well, Bergan.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Judge Drace
line_text: Such strength— Inhuman!

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Vayne; Gabranth
line_text: Zargabaath, take the Alexander. You will accompany Bergan and bring Larsa back to me. / Your Excellency, Lord Larsa was placed under my charge.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Vayne
line_text: Oh? Perhaps you mistook your orders then. / I can see no other explanation for why you were reporting and conjecturing on my doings to my late father.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Gabranth; Vayne
line_text: Your Excellency— / A hound, begging for scraps at the Emperor's table. / Would you serve another master, hound? / You may fulfil your duty as Judge Magister before us all.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Vayne
line_text: She has been tried and found guilty.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Judge Zargabaath
line_text: Your Excellency, I beg you reconsider!

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Judge Drace
line_text: Do it. I care not.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Judge Drace
line_text: Live, Gabranth. Protect the young lord. Protect Larsa...

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Gabranth; Judge Drace
line_text: Forgive me. / Pray be quick.

trigger: requested by 監督.皇帝暗殺
speaker: Vayne
line_text: And so House Solidor lives on.

speaker: Senator_A (script label)
line_text: The Rozarrian Empire assembles a vast host under guise of martial exercises. / It is our belief they wait for the proper pretext... / the sooner to make their strike against Archadia.

speaker: Senator_B (script label)
line_text: The loss of Leviathan and her fleet at such a time comes as a most grievous blow. / Were Rozarria to invade, the battle would be hard-fought. / Had Lord Vayne not deployed the fleet so capriciously... / we would not now find ourselves in such perilous circumstance.

speaker: Senator_C (script label)
line_text: Lord Vayne shall be made to answer for his actions. / It is the will of the Senate. / Excellency, though he be your son, justice must be served.

speaker: Gramis (script label)
line_text: A convenient thing, justice. And so I must now make a choice... / between my throne, and my son.

speaker: Senator_C (script label); no name shown
line_text: A most lamentable situation for us all. / Oh? For Lord Vayne, perhaps, yet surely Lord Larsa will make for a fine emperor.

speaker: Gramis (script label)
line_text: Larsa so adores his brother, and he is yet young.

speaker: Senator_A (script label)
line_text: But he will not remain young forever. / Already he busies himself unraveling Lord Vayne's tangled skein. / Lord Larsa has found his role to play, and pursues it with some enthusiasm.

speaker: Gramis (script label)
line_text: Ah, yes... And who would set him at such tasks?

speaker: Senator_B (script label)
line_text: What matter? / Lord Vayne himself once saw his elder brothers brought to like justice, did he not? / At Your Excellency's behest, as I recall.

speaker: Senator_C (script label)
line_text: You may put yourself at ease, Lord Gramis. / So long as the Senate watches over her... / Archadia's well-being will ever be ensured.

speaker: no name shown
line_text: By your will. / I shall bid Vayne return to Archades.

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Skip
